source_contract_limits.completed_cast: CastedSpellFinished captures original clicked item, slot, caster and target, plus successful native charge consumption; EVENT_CAST comes after SpellFinished and charge deletion. Raw clicked target is retained; do not use current GetTarget after the cast.
source_contract_limits.lens_damage: Native Damage remains attributed to the actual item user. CommonDamage applies magical mitigation/runes; actual configured-skull lethal result must be native-tested, not inferred from a mocked Damage call.
source_contract_limits.kill_order: Native task Kill update/unlock occurs before KilledMerit, so follow/return stages5/11 are visible to the corresponding real kill callbacks.
source_contract_limits.global_npc: QuestParserCollection dispatches local and global NPC events separately; lens producer fragment composes global predecessors and filters exact ordinary evil-eye IDs.
